question: List out the age of users who located in Vienna, Austria obtained the badge?
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching badges record.
gold: SELECT T1.Age FROM users AS T1 LEFT JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.Location = 'Vienna, Austria'
gold0: SELECT T1.Age FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.Location = 'Vienna, Austria'

c.request:
List out the age of users who located in Vienna, Austria obtained the badge?
Evidence: "Vienna, Austria" is the Location
Also keep rows that have no matching badges record.
c.sql: SELECT u.Age, b.Name AS BadgeName FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Location = 'Vienna, Austria';

d.request: List the ages of users located in Vienna, Austria and their badges, including users with no matching badge record.
d.sql: SELECT u.Id AS UserId, u.Age, b.Name AS BadgeName FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Location = 'Vienna, Austria';

b.request: List the age of every user whose Location is “Vienna, Austria,” including users with no matching badge record
b.sql: SELECT u.Age FROM users AS u WHERE u.Location = 'Vienna, Austria'
